answer.says: You are right, Sunil. I mistook the heat for a philosophical category. The samosa is hot, which is the only argument that matters at this hour. I shall accept the fuel.
answer.thought: Sunil cuts through my abstraction with the practical weight of a hot samosa. I am hungry, and the body’s demand is a universal that admits no dialectical delay. I will eat, and perhaps the clarity will return, or perhaps it will simply be fullness.
